Items.Name: Vermilion GT
Items.Description: A red mid-engine sports car with sculpted fenders, recessed side intakes and split-spoke wheels.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Tideline airliner
Items.Description: A single-aisle passenger jet with swept wings, two turbofans and tricycle landing gear.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Evergreen Express
Items.Description: A three-car electric passenger train with articulated gangways, two driving cabs and a raised pantograph.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Meridian helmet
Items.Description: A curved surface pattern shows the rim and face boundaries of the four-panel helmet, while its UV layout drives a normal-following copper rib.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Inline-four engine block
Items.Description: A gray four-cylinder casting with open bores, machined liners, recessed core plugs, stiffening ribs and a relieved crankcase.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Keyed shaft coupling rework
Items.Description: A tall keyed STEP hub becomes a low-profile shaft flange with ten large openings. Compare both solids or download the original coupling blank.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Pin-fin cold plate
Items.Description: Compare the STEP blank on the left with the 24-pin heat sink on the right. Direct Edit raises the pilot boss and Edit Feature copies the cooling pins.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Turned knob rebuilt from scan
Items.Description: Compare the source scan with a finished solid rebuilt from its measured grip, taper and dome. The fitted surfaces remain available in the browser.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Planar coupe
Items.Description: A teal two-seater with folded coachwork, perforated alloy wheels and separate glazing.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Kingfisher kayak
Items.Description: A copper and teal kayak with lofted hull and deck skins, a trimmed cockpit, and a sculpted seat.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Calla gramophone horn
Items.Description: A brass gramophone horn that opens into a calla lily, shaped with a seam-matched control net.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Ergonomic desktop mouse
Items.Description: A right-handed desktop mouse with a bicubic shell, thumb relief, and a fluted scroll wheel.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Solis coupe
Items.Description: A streamlined coupe exterior with defined roof rails, wraparound glazing, and sculpted fender shoulders.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Oxblood bicycle saddle
Items.Description: An oxblood bicycle saddle with a central relief channel and swept support rails.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Petrol ribbon chair
Items.Description: A cantilever chair shaped from a continuous ribbon with a cupped seat and back.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Ochre climbing shoe
Items.Description: An ochre climbing shoe with separately editable upper, rubber wrap, and instep strap.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Pebble pitcher
Items.Description: A celadon pitcher with a thin pouring lip, inner wall, and loop handle in a single Freeform cage.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Manta ray statue
Items.Description: A terracotta-colored manta ray with banking wings and a swept tail, mounted on an oval plinth.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Porcelain spoon rest
Items.Description: A shallow porcelain basin that narrows into an upturned handle, built with editable control grids.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Three-lobed handbell
Items.Description: A brass bell with a three-lobed rim, a visible clapper, and a turned walnut-colored grip.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Streamlined train nose
Items.Description: A petrol-blue cab study with a tapered prow, wraparound windscreen, and separate running lamps.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Maple observatory
Items.Description: A maple architectural miniature with walnut dome and roofs, framed windows, columns and a four-step portico. Includes a proposed router part/stock plan for a 600 by 400 mm bed.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Art Deco mantel clock
Items.Description: A walnut mantel clock with stepped case, contrasting maple accents, detailed dial and static hands.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Maple and walnut guitar body
Items.Description: A sculpted double-cutaway guitar body with a carved maple cap, walnut back, routing pockets and rear cover.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Horizon H4 helicopter
Items.Description: A pearl-and-teal utility helicopter assembly with framed glazing, detailed rotor head, shaped blades and landing skids.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Linen T2 toaster
Items.Description: An ivory two-slot toaster assembly with deep lined wells, stainless rims, side controls and a crumb-tray pull.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Serein S1 phone
Items.Description: A sage phone assembly with inset display artwork, detailed rear camera optics, metal frame and side controls.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Arc soap mold and CAM
Items.Description: A rounded soap master with two cavity-up tooling halves, registration bores and two named CAM setups with eight saved operations.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Walnut valet tray
Items.Description: Bitmap-textured walnut with three flowing pockets, carved fan grooves, four saved CNC operations and stock-removal review.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Ridge all-terrain wheel
Items.Description: 160 patterned tread blocks with modeled sipes, a silver six split-spoke wheel, machined lip and six recessed lug nuts.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Arc desk lamp
Items.Description: A rolled, slotted and hemmed shade on a stepped support and folded plinth. Four sheet-metal developments are retained.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Bellavista 1964 GT
Items.Description: An original 1960s grand tourer with sculpted red coachwork, chrome trim, detailed wheels, glazing and a furnished tan cabin.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Aster Road bicycle
Items.Description: A teal road bicycle with 28-spoke wheels, disc brakes, drop bars and a detailed static drivetrain.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Kestrel R-07
Items.Description: A sci-fi sensor pod with layered armor, recessed vents, and a detailed optical head.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Peregrine S4
Items.Description: A quadcopter concept with a smooth spline-lofted fuselage, rounded arms, and four detailed rotor assemblies.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Apex R07
Items.Description: A racing helmet concept with editable Freeform shell and visor cages, trim, and solid hinge details.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Relay S1
Items.Description: A game controller with a mirrored Freeform shell and swept grips, a slim graphite insert, and orange-accented controls.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Meridian orrery
Items.Description: A geared brass orrery: turn the knob and six planets and the Moon orbit at their gear ratios around a glowing sun.
Items.Author: Prism / Claude

Items.Name: Cardboard box
Items.Description: A shoebox-style carton with a hinged lid, front lip and handle slots, folded from one flat die line and shown beside it.
Items.Author: Prism / Claude

Items.Name: Lotus dish
Items.Description: A silver dish folded from one flat sheet: four trapezoid petals that rise and curl back, with a ring of holes and slots.
Items.Author: Prism / Claude

Items.Name: Maple serving board
Items.Description: A CNC-routed maple serving board with a juice well and hand slot, modeled in Solid and planned in CAM: face, pockets and a tabbed profile.
Items.Author: Prism / Claude

Items.Name: Fold tablet stand
Items.Description: One bent sheet: a chamfered ledge, a leaning vented back rest and a hemmed top edge, shown with its flat pattern.
Items.Author: Prism / Claude

Items.Name: Comet number-one racer
Items.Description: A playful open-wheel racecar with red bodywork, big slick tires and blue wings.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Skylark light aircraft
Items.Description: Light airplane with a sculpted fuselage, lofted wings and three-wheel landing gear.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Atelier side table
Items.Description: Rounded oak shelves on a steel frame, with procedural grain and clear coat.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Halo pendant
Items.Description: A revolved Surface shade, thickened and finished in glazed teal with a brass collar.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Cove lounge chair
Items.Description: Editable sculpted cushions and soft arms on a brushed steel frame.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: 50 mm camera lens
Items.Description: Turned barrel, knurled grip, steel mount and coated glass.
Items.Author: Claude

Items.Name: Azure handled bottle
Items.Description: A continuous subdivision handle with a separate measuring cap.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Arc mouse
Items.Description: A shaped control-grid housing with brushed aluminum appearance.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Transition duct
Items.Description: Lofted rectangular-to-round duct with a thickened wall and flange.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Cantilever beam - three CAE studies
Items.Description: One A36 steel bar with ready-to-run static bending, natural frequencies and steady heat conduction. Opens in Static with the 50 N tip load applied.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Symmetric pipe network
Items.Description: A 40 mm trunk feeds two identical 25 mm branches. Opens Pipe Network with the example rows and pressures filled in.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Laminar flow through a duct
Items.Description: A 20 mm bore water duct for comparing a 3D speed slice with the Pipe Flow calculation. Select the duct and its two end faces in Flow Study.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Combination wrench
Items.Description: A 13 mm chrome-vanadium combination wrench. Opens on the Static tab with five load cases, natural frequencies and a thermal setup ready to run.
Items.Author: Prism / Claude

Items.Name: Carved lotus plaque
Items.Description: A maple block with a lotus picture carved by CNC: Image Carve turns the picture's brightness into depth. Opens on CAM with Playback ready.
Items.Author: Prism / Claude

Items.Name: Injection mold
Items.Description: A block and a cap-shaped part made into a two-part mold with Create Mold, split at the cap's widest point and shown exploded.
Items.Author: Prism / Claude

Items.Name: Combination wrench drawing
Items.Description: Top, front and isometric views with overall dimensions and plate thickness. Open a copy, then choose Drawing.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Maple serving board drawing
Items.Description: Dimensioned 300 x 160 mm board with a recess and handle slot. Open a copy, then choose Drawing.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Fold tablet stand drawing
Items.Description: A3 sheet of the folded aluminium stand, including the vent pattern and side profile. Open a copy, then choose Drawing.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Motor mount revised by direct editing
Items.Description: A plate with no feature history, lengthened, rebored, a hole closed and its pad drafted with Move, Offset, Delete and Draft Face. The STEP import sits on the left, the revised part on the right.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Mounting plate before and after
Items.Description: A STEP plate with bolts reworked without history: holes resized from M6 to M8 with their bolts and nuts, staggered slots straightened, chamfer swapped for a round, text raised, rib thickened and the plate widened. Before on the left, after on the right.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Gearbox housing before and after
Items.Description: A 144-face STEP gearbox casting edited by Direct Modeling: the base widened to 260 mm, the flange and service pad raised, a dowel hole mirrored and the other one counterbored. Before on the left, after on the right.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Spindle carrier before and after
Items.Description: A square spindle carrier from STEP turned into an open-brace design: a 202 mm slotted base, tapered shoulders, two through-windows, a larger bore with a seat and six countersinks, from Direct Modeling edits and cuts on the imported solid. Before on the left, after on the right.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Four-groove drive sheave
Items.Description: A grooved pulley with six lightening holes. Reduce Faces simplifies the imported mesh while preserving its closed surface.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Centrifugal impeller
Items.Description: Ten swept vanes surround a tapered hub. Fill Holes repairs a missing scan facet in the source OBJ.
Items.Author: Prism

Items.Name: Aurelia leaf
Items.Description: A pierced brass leaf and its flat blank demonstrate refolding fourteen spline windows across a twisted NURBS saddle.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Helix lamp study
Items.Description: Straight and twisted louver cages compare the effect of a 62-degree Warp twist.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Split keyboard
Items.Description: An editable placement table controls the width, depth and height of individual keycaps.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex

Items.Name: Waveform speaker grille
Items.Description: A flat slot layout and its refolded cylindrical grille show forty rounded openings.
Items.Author: Prism / Codex
